title: VXAce I'm looking to have a skill that will replace itself upon using the skill in battle.

posts.author: 8BallGamer
posts.body:
Hello. I have a skill called Uno Shot that upon use, I want the skill to be replaced another skill called Dos Shot. I would also like using Dos Shot to replace it with Tres Shot, and using Tres Shot to replace into Uno Shot. Is this possible for base RPG Maker VX Ace, or will I need a plugin?
I've attached some screenshots to show you what I have done in RPG Maker so far.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
If it's okay to have 'uno shot' greyd out, just make the skills give/remove states (removed at battle end) that have the 'seal skill' and 'add skill' traits.
If you want the base skill to not show at all, you could put in the damage formulas
a.forget_skill(X); a.learn_skill(Y); damage formula
But unless you want the upgraded shots to carry over to next battles, you'd have to forget and learn skills after the battle ends.
There might also be a script to hide/show the skills, but don't know too much about ACE scripts.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: I'd recommend a "hide skill" type of approach here because that would make it less convoluted at the end. This means you wouldn't have to add the skills again at the end of the battle.

posts.author: 8BallGamer
posts.body:
Okay I think I figured out a way to technically make the 3 skills work, but I do have some issues with the skill select menu.
As you can see with the 3 battle screenshots, when the Uno Shot status is applied via using the Uno Shot ability, uno shot becomes unusable. When using the Dos Shot ability Uno Shot is still unusable but then Dos Shot is replaced with Tres Shot. And when Tres Shot is used, it makes Tres Shot go away and Uno Shot re-usable again. This loop technically works, but i would like Uno Shot status & Dos Shot status to completely remove Uno Shot ability from the menu. Is this possible?
